notesStmt.note: One page is written on the back of an opened envelope addressed to Whitman and postmarked "Scarborough," December 20, 1888, meaning that the draft was written some time between then and February 1890, when the poem was first published.

An early draft of "Old Age's Ship and Crafty Death's," a poem first published in the February 1890 issue of The Century Magazine. Whitman subsequently included it in Good-Bye My Fancy (1891) and in the printing of Leaves of Grass that he oversaw just before his death.
